# Page 5^page=5
Why Handloom is Important? • The handloom sector is the largest cottage industry in India, with about 28 lakh looms • According to the Handloom Census 2019-20, about 35.22 lakh handloom workers were employed across the country, out of which 25.46 lakh were women with a share of 72.29%. • The sector employs 26.73 lakh weavers directly and indirectly throughout the country with 72% of them being women. • India exports handloom products to more than 20 countries in the world. Some of the top importers are the USA, UAE, Netherlands, France, UK, Italy, Greece, Germany and Australia.
